literal: Rolling game unceasingly if one calls, wealth income having gone outside indeed will fall.
translation: If one constantly calls the roll in the game of dice, their wealth and income will depart and fall to outsiders.
modern: உருளும் சூதாட்டத்தை இடைவிடாமல் ஆடினால், ஒருவனது பொருளும் வருவாயும் அவனை விட்டு விலகிப் பிறரிடமே சென்று சேரும்.
explanation: The couplet warns against the addiction of gambling. The phrase urul ayam refers to the game of rolling dice, while porul ayam refers to one's accumulated wealth and incoming revenue. If a person constantly calls out the dice rolls without stopping, all their wealth and income will leave them and fall into the hands of outsiders. The play on the word ayam, meaning both a game and income, highlights how engaging in the former destroys the latter.
